## Constraints worth knowing

<!--
  Some of these are load-bearing and were decided deliberately. A proposal that breaks
  one needs to say so out loud:

  - No cookie is set, and there is no analytics (client requirement)
  - The inquiry form collects no postal address
  - The captcha is local arithmetic — no third-party service
  - `/admin` has a client-side gate that is NOT access control
  - Marketing components are bespoke; `/admin` is registry-only (PRD §7, §8)
-->
